scripts.dev: prisma migrate deploy && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.db:reset: node -e "if(process.env.NODE_ENV==='production'){console.error('Refusing to reset in production');process.exit(1)}" && prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:reset:data: node -e "if(process.env.NODE_ENV==='production'){console.error('Refusing to wipe data in production');process.exit(1)}" && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f prisma/reset.sql && pnpm db:seed
